methods.name: isRooted
methods.comment:
Performs the default root/jailbreak detection checks.

This is the recommended method for basic root/jailbreak detection.
It runs a combination of the most reliable detection heuristics for the platform.
Works on both Android and iOS.

methods.name: isRootedWithBusyBox
methods.comment: Extends the default detection with BusyBox specific checks (Android only).

methods.name: detectRootManagementApps
methods.comment: Detects if known root management applications are present (Android only).

methods.name: detectPotentiallyDangerousApps
methods.comment: Detects potentially dangerous applications commonly found on rooted devices (Android only).

methods.name: detectTestKeys
methods.comment: Detects debug/test build tags (Android only).

methods.name: checkForBusyBoxBinary
methods.comment: Checks whether a BusyBox binary exists on the device (Android only).

methods.name: checkForSuBinary
methods.comment: Checks whether a `su` binary is present (Android only).

methods.name: checkSuExists
methods.comment: Detects if the `su` binary can be executed (Android only).

methods.name: checkForRWPaths
methods.comment: Detects world writable system paths (Android only).

methods.name: checkForDangerousProps
methods.comment: Detects dangerous system properties (Android only).

methods.name: checkForRootNative
methods.comment: Executes RootBeer native checks (Android only).

methods.name: detectRootCloakingApps
methods.comment: Detects applications that can hide root (Android only).

methods.name: isSelinuxFlagInEnabled
methods.comment: Checks the SELinux enforcement state (Android only).

methods.name: isExistBuildTags
methods.comment: Detects test build tags on the OS image (Android only).

methods.name: doesSuperuserApkExist
methods.comment: Detects if superuser APKs are installed (Android only).

methods.name: isExistSUPath
methods.comment: Checks for known `su` binary locations (Android only).

methods.name: checkDirPermissions
methods.comment: Detects writable directories that should be protected (Android only).

methods.name: checkExecutingCommands
methods.comment: Executes `which su` style commands to detect root (Android only).

methods.name: checkInstalledPackages
methods.comment: Detects suspicious installed packages (Android only).

methods.name: checkforOverTheAirCertificates
methods.comment: Detects tampered OTA certificates (Android only).

methods.name: isRunningOnEmulator
methods.comment: Detects common emulator fingerprints (Android only).

methods.name: simpleCheckEmulator
methods.comment: Performs a lightweight emulator check (Android only).

methods.name: simpleCheckSDKBF86
methods.comment: Detects x86 emulator fingerprints (Android only).

methods.name: simpleCheckQRREFPH
methods.comment: Detects QC reference phone builds (Android only).

methods.name: simpleCheckBuild
methods.comment: Detects build host anomalies (Android only).

methods.name: checkGenymotion
methods.comment: Detects Genymotion emulator fingerprints (Android only).

methods.name: checkGeneric
methods.comment: Detects generic emulator fingerprints (Android only).

methods.name: checkGoogleSDK
methods.comment: Detects Google SDK emulator fingerprints (Android only).

methods.name: togetDeviceInfo
methods.comment:
Returns device information collected during detection.

Provides additional context and metadata about the device that was
gathered during the root detection process. Useful for debugging
and logging purposes.

methods.name: isRootedWithEmulator
methods.comment: Extends the default detection with emulator heuristics (Android only).

methods.name: isRootedWithBusyBoxWithEmulator
methods.comment: Extends the BusyBox detection with emulator heuristics (Android only).

methods.name: getPluginVersion
methods.comment: Get the native Capacitor plugin version.
